cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: come back · /ˌkʌm ˈbæk/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to return to a place where you were before. Please come back tomorrow.
stay in · /ˌsteɪ ˈɪn/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to remain at home instead of going out. We stay in and cook dinner tonight.
make yourself at home · /ˌmeɪk jɚˌsɛlf ət ˈhoʊm/ · fixed expression · Phrase · New
a friendly invitation to relax and feel comfortable in someone's home. Come in and make yourself at home.
get home · /ˌɡɛt ˈhoʊm/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to arrive at your home. I get home at six.
to come or go back to a place. What time will you return?
Cover the words. Say three from memory. Make a new sentence with one, then check the example.
